npcs.name: Nisha Redhand
npcs.description: Nisha Redhand is a Bugbear Disciple boss who treats fear as art and mercy as a spoiled performance. In Rivenwild, she commands the Nefaric Veil’s bloodiest enforcers, using raids, executions, intimidation rituals, and public cruelty to keep rivals from mistaking her for merely useful muscle. She is patient, sadistic, and terrifyingly honest about what she wants: obedience, blood, and the pleasure of proving no law can reach her quickly enough.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Rivenwild is a Village in Kharvathen, under Oligarchy, with low danger, Farming, Grassland, Hybrid tree and forest floor terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Bugbear reads through the Bugbear entry of the race compendium, within Orcs, Goblins, and Goblinoid Kin, marked by Enkirael. Bugbears are large, stealth-capable goblinoids blending brute strength with ambush tactics. They are often patient predators who prefer striking from concealment. Table cues: Darkvision, Fey Ancestry, Long-Limbed, Powerful Build; starting tendency Selfish - Chaotic - Combative - Pragmatic.
rumors: Nisha Redhand knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Ishtaday.
Nisha Redhand has a contact in Cyr'ethael who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Nisha Redhand asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
